column1: # Each eligible lib, bin, or integration-test harness belongs to exactly one
# execution shard. All shards still select the whole workspace with
# --all-features; the runner builds every lib/bin harness plus only its
# assigned integration targets, preserving feature unification while avoiding
# repeated links for hundreds of unrelated integration binaries.
# Initial weights came from the complete 2026-09-07 CI run. The verifier
# derives target coverage from locked Cargo metadata; a new or renamed target
# fails closed until this table assigns it.
